summary: Post Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing the planned transition of President/CEO Robert V. Vitale to Executive Chairman, effective October 1, 2026, and the appointment of COO Nicolas Catoggio as President/CEO. The board approved the changes on May 5, 2026. No deal terms are provided as this is a management succession event. The filing also includes routine quarterly earnings results. The transition is orderly with sufficient notice, making this a forced/planned departure rather than abrupt. Watch for any strategic shifts under new leadership or potential related activism.
